sections.title: OVERNIGHT MAP
sections.content:
- US tape cooled: Nasdaq sold off, S&P slipped, Dow was near flat; the book’s pain was concentrated in crowded AI / chip-beta rather than broad risk-off.
- Asia is not giving a clean rescue yet: HK is still pre-open on Yahoo, while Japan and Korea last closed firmer; oil fell, gold stayed bid.
Anchor numbers: Nasdaq -0.66%, S&P 500 -0.22%, Dow -0.03%; NQ futures -1.56%, oil -2.17%, gold +0.63%.

sections.title: US CLOSE MOVERS
sections.content:
- GDS +5.26%: ADR strength stood out, but HK account exposure is 9698.HK, so treat this as sentiment read-through, not the account move.
- MSFT +3.02%: best core-quality line in the US book; software quality held while semis cracked.
- BABA +2.09%: ADR bounce, useful read-through for HK BABA, but not a substitute for 9988.HK live pricing.
- MU -10.57%: main damage; AI memory beta remains hypersensitive after the prior run.
- INTC -9.03%: weak legacy/value sleeve; this is not behaving like a defensive rerating name.
- DXYZ -3.61%, ETN -3.24%: speculative/private-market proxy and AI power-equipment beta both de-risked.

sections.title: HK LIVE MOVERS
sections.content:
- HK is pre-open: Yahoo regular-market timestamps for 2800.HK, 9988.HK, 9698.HK and 1816.HK still point to the prior HK session, not today’s live trade.
- Last completed HK moves: 1816.HK -1.47%, 9698.HK -1.40%, 2800.HK -0.51%, 9988.HK -0.16%; breadth was soft, but not a fresh live signal yet.
- Watch the open for whether ADR strength in BABA/GDS carries into 9988.HK/9698.HK or gets faded.

sections.title: MARKET NEWS
sections.content:
- Reuters framed the overnight tape as stocks flat-to-lower while traders digested Fed comments; the practical effect was higher sensitivity to valuation-heavy tech.
- Oil fell while gold rose, which helped ballast but did not fully offset the AI-beta drawdown inside the US sleeve.

sections.title: ACTION BOARD
sections.content:
- Opportunity: If HK opens weak despite BABA/GDS ADR strength, 9988.HK and broad 2800.HK become the cleaner places to watch before chasing US chip volatility.
- Risk: MU and INTC are flashing idiosyncratic damage, so do not treat the US tech pullback as a simple buy-the-dip until semis stabilize.
- Research: Re-check whether MU’s move is earnings/guide-specific or a broader AI memory derating, because that decides whether NVDA/MSFT weakness is sympathy or contagion.
